patterns.name: Credit Card Debit
patterns.regex: ICICI Bank Credit Card .*? debited for (?:INR|Rs\.?)\s*([\d,.]+) on ([\d-A-Za-z-]+) for (?:UPI-(\d+)-)?([^.]+)

patterns.name: Account Debit
patterns.regex: ICICI Bank Acct .*? debited for (?:INR|Rs\.?)\s*([\d,.]+) on ([\d-A-Za-z-]+);\s*([^;]+)\s+credited.*?UPI:(\d+)
